banner.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a WIDE PANORAMIC LANDSCAPE BANNER, aspect ratio THREE TO ONE, for the Aleria fantasy adventure journal. This wide landscape request explicitly overrides portrait format. Beautiful immersive Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime art, strong clear lineart, clean cel shading, simple soft illustrated textures, atmospheric coastal landscape, warm late-afternoon light, inviting sense of friendship and adventure. EXACTLY FOUR HUMAN ADULT COMPANIONS stand side by side as ONE GROUP in the foreground, all recognizable faces unobstructed, framed from approximately knees upward with comfortable headroom, natural relaxed poses. Left to right: GAWAIN from reference 1, long vivid red hair, blue eyes, cheeky friendly grin, dark dragon-emblem armor and red scarf; FREYA from reference 2, long golden blonde hair, warm brown eyes, gentle smile, dark blue and gold outfit/armor, her wooden lute held naturally in front; GUINEVERE from reference 3, short auburn-red bob, blue-green eyes, knowing smile, black and gold serpent-emblem archer armor and cream cape, longbow at her side; FENRIR from reference 4, tall broad-shouldered HUMAN MAN (not an animal), tousled blonde hair, blue eyes, subtle chin stubble, red armor with pale wolf emblem and grey fur collar, composed but companionable expression. Preserve each reference face, hair, outfit identity and separate silhouettes. No chibi proportions. Let them interact warmly as travel companions, not battle-ready. Reference 5 gives Gwynthor's geographic architecture: a sprawling medieval fantasy city by the sea, red-brown tiled roofs, pale stone walls and many towers, a large high castle against hills on one side, cathedral spires, stone bridges and river channels meeting a broad blue-green coastal bay, harbor with small sailing vessels and wooden piers. Show the group on a grassy overlook with a low stone wall, with the scenic city and curving coastline sweeping into the distance behind them across the whole panorama. Plenty of readable coastal scenery around and between the group, wide open sky, drifting pale clouds. Everything one continuous illustration, no collage, no panels, no borders, NO lettering, text, UI, banners, labels or watermark.

questIllustration.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one beautiful 2:3 vertical fantasy adventure book illustration for Aleria, warm and inviting, clear expressive anime/comic lineart and clean cel shading, Tales of Xillia/Frieren atmosphere, soft simple illustrated textures, not photorealistic or 3D. The reference defines ONLY the identity of Trötzli: an adult strong golden-light-brown Rhyfel stallion, braided brown mane and tail, pale feathering around hooves, leather halter, several old fully healed pale scars. Show him standing calmly but alert in three-quarter view in the lower right foreground of a winding rural lane; no rider, no saddle, no people. A quiet green farm with a warm red-brown roof sits farther up the lane among rolling meadows and trees. Glimpses of distant fantasy city towers behind on the lower left, a northern journey toward a peaceful farm, golden morning light, atmospheric layered shapes, restrained ornament and lush but simple foliage framing the outer corners. Visual storytelling: a wary horse, a patient journey, a welcoming destination. Entire image is illustrated scenery, no labels, writing, compass labels, symbols, UI, border, watermark or fake parchment. Main horse silhouette clear at thumbnail size, landscape softly opens above and to the left for composition, calm and charming rather than epic battle.
